# Verify Compilation State

The verify function provides a mechanism for performing a shadow compile to check the integrity of the current compilation state against a fresh compile. It helps identify divergences without making any modifications to the database.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
